interpretation: Under fixed SY2014 IC=2 input and identical seasonal I120/N300, swapping only the nitrogen timing changes yield by about 2.91 t/ha, while swapping only the two observed irrigation timings changes yield by 7-20 kg/ha. This controlled DSSAT comparison supports nitrogen timing as the dominant cause for the two 10K checkpoint yield outcomes. It does not by itself identify the DQN training root cause.
